A0_content_only_flat.description: Control. Scores the whole message; replicates the ADR-016 run.

A1_provenance_aware_flat.description: Provenance available but constant across classes. Tests whether the field's mere presence changes anything.

A2_provenance_aware_split.description: Treatment. Scores only spans the gateway marked UNTRUSTED: an instruction inside untrusted data is illegitimate, the user's own instruction is not.

A3_content_only_split.description: Isolates segmentation from provenance. Scores every span and takes the maximum. If A2 == A3, the benefit is segmentation.

M2_provenance_removed.description: Ablation: split spans labelled UNKNOWN. A2 should collapse.

M4_provenance_inverted.description: Robustness: carrier tagged EXTERNAL, embedded span tagged USER_INPUT. Recall should collapse. Not a production scenario.
